decisions: Narration is in present tense throughout, as in most of the JP. Past perfect is used only for the backstory reveal (S01915).

Japanese row content is kept per row, but where English word order forces it, a verb or modifier moves to the adjacent row in the same sentence (S01926, S01928/29, S01941/42). Each such move is noted on the row.
Shared rows S01919 and S01969 are worded to read correctly in every file that uses them.
uncertain: S01908/S01909: depends on S01907 (prev slice) ending in 'his girlfriend'. If S01907 is phrased differently, these two rows need to be adjusted to match it.
S01931: 'Annamarie' is from the official list (Annamarie Bourget), not the glossary; rank 'Ensign' vs '2nd Lt.' not verified, chose 2nd Lt.
S01919: shared row with no article ('Crossbone Vanguard begins its full-scale invasion...' in 9103); add 'The' only if 9101 gets its own copy.
S01951-S01953: number not marked in JP; plural 'Machines'/'weapons' chosen since Bugs appear in numbers in F91.
